name: cta-split-image
title: Split CTA with product visual
description: Two-column CTA card with a benefit list and a dashboard mock-up, traced by an animated border beam.

standards.purpose: Close a section by offering one clear next step.
useWhen: The reader already has enough context to act.
doNotUseWhen: The action is unavailable, or the surface is inside the product.

rules.check: One primary action; any secondary action is visually subordinate.
The action label names the outcome (start trial, book a demo), never a bare 'Submit'.
Action text and background meet WCAG AA in both light and dark themes.
